title: Massive MSFS 2024 scenery drop! iniBuilds Baghdad v2, Billund & Global vegetation overhaul
description:
If you're looking to expand your flight routes and visual approaches, the Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Marketplace just dropped an incredible scenery lineup. This week delivers everything from rebuilt international passenger hubs and Lego-land gateways to scenic Irish regional strips, tropical Caribbean getaways, and comprehensive global world overhauls!

In this comprehensive scenery breakdown, we inspect all the new commercial hubs, regional airfields, VFR landmarks, vegetation reworks, and night lighting packages to help you decide what's claiming top priority on your virtual flight line:

✈️ INTERNATIONAL & REGIONAL COMMERCIAL GATEWAYS
We kick off in the Middle East with iniBuilds' premium overhaul of Baghdad International Airport v2 (ORBI), exploring its rebuilt aprons, landside infrastructure, operational hangars, ground equipment, and detailed terminal interiors. Next, we head to Denmark to explore Billund Airport (EKBI)—the historic international gateway founded right beside the Lego Group—featuring hand-crafted PBR markings, realistic cargo and terminal architecture, custom elevation profiles, and GSX profile integration. We also stop by Waterford Airport (EIWF) by UK2000 Scenery, exploring the only airport in southeast Ireland, complete with static search and rescue (SAR) helicopters and GA training facilities.

🏝️ TROPICAL COASTAL & ISLAND GETAWAYS
Shifting into scenic island hopping and low-altitude coastal cruising, CLI4D Designs brings the Caribbean to life with their complete recreation of Terre-de-Haut in Guadeloupe (Les Saintes). We inspect the custom 3D architectural models, coastal resorts, authentic rock and elevation texturing, refined island roads, and dedicated helipads built for both fixed-wing and rotorcraft pilots.

🌲 ENVIRONMENT OVERHAULS & NOCTURNAL CITY GRIDS
Looking to upgrade your global immersion? Burning Blue Design introduces Enhanced Global Vegetation, overhauling all 848 default MSFS 2024 eco-regions with biome-aware density, 242 custom tree species, native grasses, and seasonal tuning. Finally, we review DreamScenery’s latest wave of Enhanced Road & Night Lights, examining urban illumination and street grid upgrades across Portland, Providence, Islamabad, Granada, Coventry, and Düsseldorf.

Which of these new destinations or visual overhauls is landing on your SSD first? Flying long-haul routes into Baghdad, setting up European commuter hops to Billund, or island hopping across Guadeloupe? Let us know in the comments below!

If this marketplace guide helped you navigate the latest MSFS 2024 additions, remember to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel for weekly sim coverage, and blue skies on your next flight!
